author: Rant-Man
quote:
This game is amazing. It's apparently a tribute to King's Field (which I never actually played) and it's got a fantastic retro style. The graphic style is beautiful, the exploration fantastic and I love how it doesn't hold your hand and you're free to explore and experiment without being pestered by tutorials and "yellow paint" every three seconds. Having a blast with this game.
Also MASSIVE props to their options menu, it's one of the most comprehensive I've seen lately, i.e. you can even edit how much you want to see the crosshair, if at all.
Fantastic game.
